content:
Keeping this short - it's Christmas Eve. I've been talking to a lot of e-commerce professionals lately about AI and content. I shared the Content Cucumber experience - how ChatGPT made our writers feel like they had less value overnight.

In this issue

  • AI Distrust is Real and Growing. More than half of consumers report reduced engagement with content they believe is AI-produced.
  • The Revenue You're Leaving Behind. This isn't just a brand issue. It's a revenue problem.
  • Why AI Made This Worse Before It Can Make It Better. Everyone rushed to adopt AI writing tools. I started Content Basis to leverage AI and train it.
  • I Built Something. I kept watching brands struggle. I kept seeing the same pattern: talented writers, solid brand guidelines, inconsistent output at scale.
  • I Need Your Feedback. We're in pre-launch right now. I've built the website to explain what RequestDesk does, but I'm too close to it.
  • Promotional Assets. Your Brand Sounds Different Everywhere and It's Costing You Money
